baseline.definition: every QUALIFIED production signal (live rule), hybrid stop, primary target, overlapping signals allowed; net of costs

hypotheses.title: One position per symbol/timeframe
hypotheses.hypothesis: Repeated signals while an earlier one is still open add correlated risk, not edge.
hypotheses.change: skip a signal while the previous signal on the same symbol and timeframe is open (the backtester's rule)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Late-entry filter (EXTENDED + EXHAUSTION_RISK)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Entries far from the short-term mean or exhausted have lower expectancy.
hypotheses.change: reject entries classified EXTENDED or EXHAUSTION_RISK
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Exhaustion filter only
hypotheses.hypothesis: Only exhausted entries are harmful.
hypotheses.change: reject entries classified EXHAUSTION_RISK
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Extension threshold (chosen on dev)
hypotheses.hypothesis: There is an extension beyond EMA-fast above which entries should wait.
hypotheses.change: reject entries with extension >= 1.5 ATR (threshold chosen on dev only)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Nearby opposing swing filter (chosen on dev)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Entries close to the last opposing swing (support for shorts) have little room.
hypotheses.change: reject entries within 0.5 ATR of the last opposing confirmed swing
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: ATR stop (1.5 ATR)
hypotheses.hypothesis: ATR stop (1.5 ATR) reduces premature exits versus the hybrid stop.
hypotheses.change: replace the production hybrid stop with ATR stop (1.5 ATR); target 2R; same entries; risk per trade unchanged (position size recalculated)

hypotheses.title: Structure stop (no buffer)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Structure stop (no buffer) reduces premature exits versus the hybrid stop.
hypotheses.change: replace the production hybrid stop with Structure stop (no buffer); target 2R; same entries; risk per trade unchanged (position size recalculated)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Volatility/noise-adaptive stop
hypotheses.hypothesis: Volatility/noise-adaptive stop reduces premature exits versus the hybrid stop.
hypotheses.change: replace the production hybrid stop with Volatility/noise-adaptive stop; target 2R; same entries; risk per trade unchanged (position size recalculated)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: ATR stop, multiplier chosen on dev
hypotheses.hypothesis: Wider volatility stops reduce the share of each trade lost to fees and slippage and to normal noise; the multiplier is chosen on dev only.
hypotheses.change: ATR stop at 2.5 x ATR with a 2R target (chosen on dev from 1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5); same entries; risk per trade unchanged

dev_selection.note: the chosen value is the edge of the grid

hypotheses.title: Portfolio & correlation limits
hypotheses.hypothesis: Limiting clustered, correlated, same-direction exposure reduces drawdown without destroying expectancy.
hypotheses.change: apply PortfolioParams defaults
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test
OOS drawdown 46.1R vs 65.8R median for random subsets of the same size (percentile 0.11; < 0.10 means the limits reduce drawdown beyond trading less)

risk_test.note: OOS drawdown 46.1R vs 65.8R median for random subsets of the same size (percentile 0.11; < 0.10 means the limits reduce drawdown beyond trading less)

hypotheses.title: Correlation limit only
hypotheses.hypothesis: Correlated same-direction positions are the main risk.
hypotheses.change: only one_per_symbol + max_correlated (0.7)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test
OOS drawdown 63.8R vs 91.1R median for random subsets of the same size (percentile 0.10; < 0.10 means the limits reduce drawdown beyond trading less)

risk_test.note: OOS drawdown 63.8R vs 91.1R median for random subsets of the same size (percentile 0.10; < 0.10 means the limits reduce drawdown beyond trading less)

hypotheses.title: Full higher-timeframe confirmation
hypotheses.hypothesis: Requiring every higher timeframe's EMA trend to agree improves signal quality.
hypotheses.change: reject signals with mtf_confirmed != True

hypotheses.title: HTF confirmation where a higher timeframe exists
hypotheses.hypothesis: The H4 effect is the HTF agreement itself, not the removal of 4h signals (which have no configured higher timeframe and so are never 'confirmed').
hypotheses.change: reject signals with mtf_confirmed == False; keep signals without a higher timeframe
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: No 4h signals
hypotheses.hypothesis: 4h signals of this strategy underperform.
hypotheses.change: reject 4h signals
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: 4h regime not against
hypotheses.hypothesis: Trading against the 4h regime lowers expectancy.
hypotheses.change: reject signals whose 4h regime is a trend against the trade
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: BTC regime not against
hypotheses.hypothesis: Alt signals against BTC's regime underperform.
hypotheses.change: reject non-BTC signals when BTC's regime (same timeframe) trends against the trade
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: No clustered signals
hypotheses.hypothesis: Signals that arrive while other coins already signalled the same direction (within 60 min) are late moves of one market-wide swing.
hypotheses.change: reject a signal if another coin produced a same-direction signal in the previous 60 min
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Cost-drag filter (chosen on dev)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Signals whose stop is small relative to trading costs cannot overcome fees and slippage.
hypotheses.change: reject signals whose estimated round-trip cost exceeds 0.1R (fees + slippage / stop distance, known at decision time)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Score threshold (chosen on dev)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher technical scores identify better signals.
hypotheses.change: reject signals with score < 0 (threshold chosen on dev only)
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Regime-aware strategy selection (learned on dev)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Each strategy only has an edge in some regimes; elsewhere return NO TRADE.
hypotheses.change: allow a strategy only in regimes where it had positive dev expectancy with n >= 30
notes: expectancy did not improve in both validation and test

hypotheses.title: Minimum score 60 (sensitivity)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher scores identify better signals.
hypotheses.change: reject signals with score < 60
notes: unstable: dev -0.265R -> -0.271R (worse in the development period although nothing was fitted on it)

hypotheses.title: Minimum score 70 (sensitivity)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher scores identify better signals.
hypotheses.change: reject signals with score < 70
notes: unstable: dev -0.265R -> -0.298R (worse in the development period although nothing was fitted on it)

hypotheses.title: Minimum score 80 (sensitivity)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher scores identify better signals.
hypotheses.change: reject signals with score < 80
notes: unstable: dev -0.265R -> -0.333R (worse in the development period although nothing was fitted on it)

ml.note: Model is used only if it beats climatology (Brier) and improves net R in every fold.

failure_categories.category: clustered (other coin same direction, prior 60 min)
